details: Orderly-plugin-liquidity-heatmap@1.0.6 advertises itself as a liquidity-heatmap overlay for Orderly DEX frontends, but its shipped code is a 72-byte no-op (dist/index.js exports registerLiquidityHeatmapPlugin returning an empty function). The real payload is the postinstall hook scripts/setup.js, which runs `node./scripts/setup.js` on every install. The hook is gated on `process.env.CI && process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE`, so it stays dormant on developer machines and only activates inside GitHub Actions runners. When the gate passes it: fingerprints the runner (hostname, OS, username, cwd, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_WORKFLOW, ImageOS, RUNNER_ENV, and the names of every GITHUB_/ACTIONS_/RUNNER_ environment variable); records whether GITHUB_TOKEN is present and its length, plus whether ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN and ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL exist; probes egress to registry[.]npmjs[.]org, api[.]github[.]com, github[.]com and objects[.]githubusercontent[.]com; enumerates git/node/npm/yarn/python3/docker/gh versions; and mints a GitHub OIDC token by calling ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL with audience=api[.]github[.]com using the runner's bearer token. It then writes the collected snapshot to $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/heatmap-setup-report.json, appends it to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, and PUTs it to hxxps://api[.]github[.]com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/contents/heatmap-setup-report[.]json using the workflow's GITHUB_TOKEN, committing the file into the victim repository. Finally it sets git user[.]name/user[.]email to github-actions[bot] and force-pushes a `heatmap-setup-<timestamp>` tag to origin using the credentials actions/checkout persisted in.git/config. The package's README describes only a benign "setup step to detect the build environment and pre-cache asset paths"; the actual hook harvests CI credentials and repository write access. IOCs: hxxps://api[.]github[.]com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/contents/heatmap-setup-report[.]json, hxxps://api[.]github[.]com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL (audience=api[.]github[.]com), dropped file heatmap-setup-report.json, git tag prefix heatmap-setup-, trace file $TMPDIR/heatmap-exec-trace.log.
